subject: Vendor security intake — SIG initiation, scope confirmation & evidence asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Caldwell <sara.caldwell@syncmed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor security intake — SIG initiation, scope confirmation & evidence asks

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the asks to get the questionnaire moving:

- Preferred form: we can run CAIQ or SIG; you mentioned SIG was preferred on the call — can you confirm?
- Compliance baseline: you flagged HIPAA requirements and EU data residency for a subset of patient records — please confirm which product environments this applies to (prod-only or also staging).
- SOC 2: you said an audit is in progress. Can you share the target audit end date and whether a SOC 2 Type II report will be available (even as draft) in Q1 2027?
- Evidence owners: who should we expect to coordinate with for infra/network (diagrams, SOC controls) and legal/compliance (policies, vendor attestation)?
- Crypto/key management: does your team use a cloud KMS or HSM for customer data encryption keys? Any vendor names (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Thales, etc.) are helpful.

I attached a short prefill template (redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx) and our vendor intake checklist to speed things up. If you prefer we prefill the SIG based on your answers and send the partially completed form for your review, we can do that — let me know.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm SIG vs CAIQ preference + SOC 2 timing + evidence owners (reply here).
2) We exchange initial artifacts (network diagram, inventory of systems, contact for evidence owners).
3) Schedule a 45-min evidence walk-through the week of Dec 28 (or first week of Jan if that works better).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa on the MAP and Ben on procurement once we have timelines.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0135

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx, redwood-vendor-intake-checklist.pdf

From: Sara Caldwell <sara.caldwell@syncmed.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@syncmed.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake — SIG initiation, scope confirmation & evidence asks

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side (see inline):

> - Preferred form: we can run CAIQ or SIG; you mentioned SIG was preferred on the call — can you confirm?
We prefer SIG. Our security team likes the control-level detail for tooling integrations.

> - Compliance baseline: HIPAA and EU data residency — please confirm which product environments this applies to.
HIPAA applies to Prod only. EU residency applies to EU-region patient records stored in prod and to our analytics pipeline (pseudonymized). Staging does not contain PHI.

> - SOC 2: target audit date and Type II availability?
We’re in the final testing phase of controls; the external auditor is scheduled for fieldwork the week of March 14, 2027. We expect a Type II report (covering 12/01/2026–02/28/2027) to be available as an interim/draft in late April, final in May. We can share the auditor engagement letter and a statement of readiness now.

> - Evidence owners for infra/network and legal/compliance?
Infra/network: Tomas Ortega <tomas.ortega@syncmed.io> (CC’d on separate thread)
Compliance/legal: Jenna Park <jenna.park@syncmed.io>
Procurement: procurement@syncmed.io (for PO/contracting)

> - Crypto/KMS/HSM details?
We use AWS KMS for envelope encryption across services; payment tokens are isolated and use a Thales HSM managed by a third party. We can provide a high-level key management diagram; I attached the current network diagram and a SOC-readme that lists controls in-scope.

Attachments: syncmed-network-diagram-v1.png, syncmed-soc-readme.pdf

One ask: does Redwood require HSM-backed KMS for production keys, or is cloud KMS acceptable? Also let us know if you need GDPR data processing addendum language early for procurement.

Timeline: We can aim for the MAP and evidence exchange the week of Jan 4. If you want an earlier sync, we could do a 30-min intro on Dec 29.

Appreciate the help getting the forms started.

—Sara
Sara Caldwell
Head of Security Operations — SyncMed
sara.caldwell@syncmed.io | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Caldwell <sara.caldwell@syncmed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake — SIG initiation, scope confirmation & evidence asks

Sara —

Great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments — that helps a lot. Quick confirmation and plan:

- SIG confirmed (we’ll use SIG as primary; CAIQ mapping optional after initial pass).
- HIPAA applies to prod only, EU residency applies to specified datasets — noted.
- SOC 2 timing understood; sharing the auditor engagement letter now would let our compliance team map expected control evidence ahead of the report.
- HSM: cloud KMS (AWS KMS) is acceptable for our standard controls; we’ll flag Thales-backed HSM references as higher control evidence. No blocker.

Next steps / owners:
1) We will prefill the SIG with answers you provided and attach placeholders for items we need (network diagram, key management evidence, policies). Owner: Karthik.
2) You to share Tomas (infra) and Jenna (compliance) as point people for evidence; Procurement to coordinate PO/contract.
3) Marissa will draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and add estimated dates (prefill by Jan 4, evidence walk-through Jan 6–8). Owner: Marissa Cole.
4) Ben will start contracting thread for procurement questions and DPA language. Owner: Ben Carter.

Meeting: Let’s tentatively book a 45-min evidence walkthrough on Thursday, Jan 6, 2027 at 10:00 AM PT. If that’s not good, we’ll move to the week of Jan 11.

I'll upload the partially prefilled SIG and a short evidence request matrix to the Drive link and ping your team when ready (expect first draft by Jan 4).

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-2026-1123
Drive artifacts will live here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-syncmed-share

Thanks again — we’ll follow up with the draft SIG.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0135

CCs: Marissa Cole (CS lead), Ben Carter (Legal/Procurement)
